title: Filter and sort screenshot filenames
source: Recurring iPhone need — users build Shortcuts to auto-delete/sort piled-up screenshots since Photos has no built-in cleanup (Gadget Hacks how-to; also mobilespoon.net). https://ios.gadgethacks.com/how-to/make-your-iphone-auto-delete-old-screenshots-so-your-photos-app-doesnt-become-hot-mess-0384935/
signature: function screenshotNames(files)  // files: string[] -> string[] (screenshots, sorted ascending)
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `screenshotNames(files)`. Given an array of filenames, return only the ones that are screenshots — a filename is a screenshot if its name (ignoring case) starts with the word "screenshot". Return them sorted in ascending (case-sensitive) order. Return an empty array if none match.
